headline: Tata Steel to Acquire 26.4% Stake in APL Apollo Tubes for $1.67 Billion
summary: Tata Steel has agreed to acquire a 26.4% stake in APL Apollo Tubes for $1.67 billion. The acquisition expands Tata Steel's downstream structural steel product portfolio.
why: Tata Steel is one of India's largest steel producers, while APL Apollo Tubes is a leading structural steel tube manufacturer.

impacts.name: Tata Steel Limited
impacts.why: Tata Steel is deploying capital to expand its domestic structural steel capacity.
